# Grade 4 Science Multimedia Lesson Plan: Weather Systems
Instructor: Marcus Vance | Room: 204 | Date: 10/14/2026

## Class Profile and Equipment
| Item | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Total Students | 22 |
| Interactive Display | ViewSonic 75-inch ViewBoard (HDMI 1) |
| Student Devices | 22 District Chromebooks (1:1 cart) |
| Headphones | 22 standard 3.5mm wired headsets |
| Software Platform | NOAA Weather Tracker App (District Portal) |

## Instructional Sequence
## Direct Instruction (15 Minutes)
- Power on the ViewBoard and open NOAA Weather Interactive via Chrome browser.
- Project the current regional radar map onto the interactive board to introduce cold fronts.
- Demonstrate cloud formation using the digital simulation software at the front station.

## Guided Group Activity (20 Minutes)
- Direct students to open their Chromebooks and launch the NOAA simulation module.
- Distribute audio headsets to all 22 learners before beginning the digital sound clips.
- Students will track air pressure changes by recording barometric data in their lab sheets.
- Ensure each student signs in using their district credentials.

## Independent Digital Assessment (10 Minutes)
- Instruct students to open the exit ticket on Google Classroom.
- Students will submit their final answers using the 18 shared iPads from the cart.

## Accommodations and Tech Contingency
- Provide closed captioning on all digital video clips for English Language Learners.
- In the event of Wi-Fi latency exceeding 300 ms, switch immediately to pre-downloaded slide deck A.
